title: 25 Frozen Micro-MTP and VTG Edge Inference
summary: Defines Frozen Micro-MTP, a small multi-token prediction head attached to frozen Semantic Core/ELM backbones on constrained GNUS edge nodes, with mandatory local verification and VTG/EGGROLL integration.
